paragraphs: I am a results-driven Cloud Engineer & Technical Project Manager, dually certified in AWS and Google Cloud, with a PMP and ISC² CC credential. I specialize in bridging the gap between executive vision and technical execution, delivering secure, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud solutions while enabling teams and stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.

Recent highlights include reducing hosting costs by 80% and achieving 100% uptime with an AWS Amplify portfolio migration, building a real-time data pipeline on Google Cloud processing 1,000+ events/second with sub-second latency, developing an AI-powered chatbot that reduced manual inquiries by 60%, managing LMS/SIS platforms for 380+ users with an 85% success rate, and scaling a nonprofit from 10 to 50+ annual participants (400% growth) while managing a $42K budget and delivering 100+ events.

blog.title: Building a Serverless Contact Form on AWS: A Step-by-Step Guide
blog.content: In this post, I walk through the architecture and implementation of my portfolio's contact form, a project that demonstrates core serverless skills using AWS Amplify, API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB. I discuss the key decisions made and the benefits of using a pay-per-use model for a high-availability, low-cost solution.

blog.title: Why I Chose a Multi-Cloud Approach: AWS and Google Cloud
blog.content: This post explores the strategic advantages of having a multi-cloud skill set. I discuss my experience and certifications with both AWS and Google Cloud Platform, and why having expertise in both ecosystems can make a professional more versatile and valuable to an organization.
